gen-fs-pramukh-rounded-gf-major-mono-dis: Major Mono Display reads like neon glass, each letter spaced well apart. Pramukh Rounded bunches its friendly glyphs tight, so the monospace text unfolds slowly, every character wrapped in generous sidebearings.
gen-fs-red-hat-display-gf-marcellus-sc: Marcellus SC reads dignified and literary, its lowercase standing tall like cast iron capitals. But Red Hat Display does its best work with a marker-like constant line, leaving daylight inside every curve.
gen-fs-red-hat-display-gf-slabo-13px: Bold marker-like lines up top, bookish serif letters below. Red Hat Display keeps a constant width through every curve, while Slabo 13px opens large counters in its tall a, e and s.
gen-gf-balsamiq-sans-gf-ibm-plex-sans-th: IBM Plex Sans Thai Looped leaves its curves gently unclosed. Balsamiq Sans is bold and expressive, its stencil-like constant stroke making the clean, neutral sans text feel hushed beside it.
